page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a marginal note at the left beside the fifth and sixth lines. Page number and running head at the top. Catchword at the lower right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: nes illis invitis sub fœdus suum trahere: quod compertum fuerit eorum aliquem in Groningenses aut horum socios aliquid deliquisse, de eo ad arbitrium quatuor virorum, duorum e Senatu Groningano duorum ex ipsis datorum satisfaciat. Pacta cum SciringiisNec multos post dies Snecani, Slotenses, Ilstani; cæterque horum socii factionis Sciringiæ, fœderis hostes, insigni clade ad Barrahusium à fœderatis correpti, cum Boccone Haringæo, factionis principe, ad arbitrium victorum conditiones acceperê. Iurarunt, fœderi Ostergoo non se semet opposituros, nec impedimento iis futuros, si qui deinceps aut Ostergoi aut Westergoi accedere eidem vellent: nullum jus imperiumve in universam Ostergoam, aut ullam ejus partem sibi arrogaturos, ablata reddituros, exules in integrum restituturos, controversa cum Galamæis arbitrio Groningensium submissuros: Groningenses in persequendis injuriis contra Westergoos hac pactione non comprehensos non impediturosː ē sociis in has leges peccanti nemini patrocinaturos detrimenta impendia, molestias belli Groninganis & Ostergois XVII millibus aureorum Rhenensium&

page.notes: Marginal note at left, "Pacta cum Scirin-giis", printed in two lines and transcribed as one note. Several words in the text are uncertain against the scan, notably "ringæo", the form of "Ostergoo" at the start of the fifth line of the paragraph, and the reading "Galamæis". The line "fœderi ... oppositurosnec" is joined in the image; I have separated it as "opposituros, nec". Ampersands at the line ends (Rhenensium&) are printed as shown. The word "XVII" is printed with spacing as "XV I I"; transcribed as XVII.
